# XYZ Fixtures

These files are byte-for-byte copies from RDKit `2026.03.1`, revision
`351f8f378f8ad6bbd517980c38896e66bf907af8c`. The selection is the complete
XYZ fixture set consumed by COSMolKit's XYZ reader parity suite, including the
intentionally empty and malformed cases.

The copied files retain RDKit's BSD-3-Clause license context.
`source_manifest.jsonl` records each upstream path, byte length, and SHA-256.
